Permissions required by samples/tenant-security.entra.json (mode: delegated, 10 resource(s))

Microsoft Graph delegated permissions
  AdministrativeUnit.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/administrativeUnits/Security AU
      (provider)
  Application.Read.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/policies/CA-Admins-PhishingResistant
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/policies/CA-SensitiveActions-StepUp
      (provider)
  Application.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/contoso-dev-security-admins
      (edge: members (when a member is a service principal))
  AuthenticationContext.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/authenticationContextClassReferences/c10
      (provider)
  Directory.Read.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/contoso-dev-security-admins
      (edge: directoryRoles; edge: members)
  Group.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/contoso-dev-break-glass
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/contoso-dev-security-admins
      (provider)
  GroupMember.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/contoso-dev-security-admins
      (edge: members)
  Policy.Read.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/authenticationStrengths/Admin phishing-resistant
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/namedLocations/Allowed countries
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/namedLocations/Contoso offices
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/policies/CA-Admins-PhishingResistant
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/policies/CA-SensitiveActions-StepUp
      (provider)
  Policy.ReadWrite.ConditionalAccess
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/authenticationStrengths/Admin phishing-resistant
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/namedLocations/Allowed countries
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/namedLocations/Contoso offices
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/policies/CA-Admins-PhishingResistant
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/policies/CA-SensitiveActions-StepUp
      (provider)
  RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/contoso-dev-security-admins
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/roleDefinitions/Security Policy Reviewer
      (edge: directoryRoles; provider)

Entra roles (the signed-in user needs at least one role of each group)
  Authentication Policy Administrator
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/authenticationStrengths/Admin phishing-resistant
      (provider)
  Conditional Access Administrator
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/authenticationContextClassReferences/c10
      (provider)
  Conditional Access Administrator | Security Administrator
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/namedLocations/Allowed countries
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/namedLocations/Contoso offices
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/policies/CA-Admins-PhishingResistant
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/policies/CA-SensitiveActions-StepUp
      (provider)
  Groups Administrator
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/contoso-dev-break-glass
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/contoso-dev-security-admins
      (edge: members; provider)
  Privileged Role Administrator
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/administrativeUnits/Security AU
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/contoso-dev-security-admins
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/roleDefinitions/Security Policy Reviewer
      (condition: isAssignableToRole; edge: directoryRoles; provider)

note: Delegated scopes must be present on the token that earm auth login obtains (the app registration of --client-id needs them as delegated permissions); the signed-in user must additionally hold at least one role of every 'Entra roles' group (the roles are alternatives).
note: Edge permissions are listed for every relationship property the template declares (including an empty array, which removes edges). Key Vault access is an Azure RBAC / access-policy requirement of the signed-in identity, not a Graph permission.
